text:
A student has two resistors.
One resistor has a resistance of 2.0Ω and the other has a resistance of 40kΩ.
Which statement is correct?
When connected in parallel, the combined resistance is 1.9Ω.
A
When connected in parallel, the combined resistance is 2.0Ω.
B
When connected in series, the combined resistance is 1.9Ω.
C
When connected in series, the combined resistance is 42Ω.
D

options.label: A
options.text: When connected in parallel, the combined resistance is 1.9Ω.

options.label: B
options.text: When connected in parallel, the combined resistance is 2.0Ω.

options.label: C
options.text: When connected in series, the combined resistance is 1.9Ω.

options.label: D
options.text: When connected in series, the combined resistance is 42Ω.
